config.section.hopper.name: Hopper Automation Settings
config.auto-harvest.name: Enable Auto-Harvest
config.auto-harvest.tooltip: If enabled, hoppers placed below a machine (Y - 1) will automatically pull and harvest finished items into the hopper.
config.adjacent-chest-output.name: Transfer Output to Chest Below
config.adjacent-chest-output.tooltip: If enabled, hoppers will automatically transfer collected items downward into a regular chest or mini-shipping bin placed directly below them (Y + 1).
config.process-interval.name: Processing Interval (Ticks)
config.process-interval.tooltip: How frequently in game ticks the hopper checks connected machines and chests. (60 ticks = 1 real-world second).
config.sound-effects.name: Play Sound Effects
config.sound-effects.tooltip: Plays subtle sound effects when items are loaded into machines below or harvested from machines above.
config.hopper-capacity.name: Hopper Inventory Capacity
config.hopper-capacity.tooltip: Total storage capacity of the hopper (36 slots default, or 70 slots expanded like Big Chest).
config.service-crab-pots.name: Auto-Bait Crab Pots
config.service-crab-pots.tooltip: Allows hoppers to load bait into crab pots below and collect catches from crab pots above.
config.service-casks.name: Service Casks
config.service-casks.tooltip: Allows hoppers to load aging ingredients into casks below and collect aged products from casks above.
